steps: stir the yeast into the warm water to dissolve add the flour stir the remaining ingredients into the flour mixture knead with dough hook or by hand until smooth and elastic place dough in a lightly greased bowl and cover allow to rise in a warm place for 30 minutes punch down the dough and divide into portions on a lightly floured surface , roll the dough into very thin rounds and top as desired bake at 400f until crisp and golden brown , approx 8-12 minutes rolled dough may be stored in the freezer i have kept rolled dough in the freezer for several months with the only effect being a less puffy baked crust

name: Simple and sweet ham glaze
ingredients: light brown sugar|honey|orange juice
steps: mix all ingredients together to use the glaze , remove your ham from the oven when there's 30 minutes left pour off any drippings that have accumulated in your pan take a sharp knife and score the ham in a criss-cross pattern if it's a spiral ham , making a set of vertical cuts should be fine use about a third of the glaze to coat the ham , and return to 400f oven for 8-10 minutes repeat applications of the glaze 1-2 more times , returning the ham to cook for about 8 to 10 minutes after each application of the glaze be sure not to use glaze in the bottom of the pan - this will dull the sheen

name: Simple and tasty garlic bread
ingredients: french bread|olive oil|garlic salt|italian seasoning|parmesan cheese|mozzarella cheese
steps: cut your bread into 1 / 2 inch slices brush olive oil onto one side of each slice add garlic salt to each slice layer each slice with the parmesan then with mozzarella on top of that italian seasoning on the very top bake at 400 f for about 5 minutes , then switch to broiler for a couple additional minutes this will help it brown nicely and bring out the flavor in the italian seasonings which is why it's important it is on top

name: Simple and tasty indian spinach sukhi paalak
ingredients: oil|black mustard seeds|fenugreek seeds|asafoetida powder|red chili powder|salt|frozen chopped spinach
steps: heat oil in medium sized pan on medium heat , add mustard seeds , fenugreek and asafetida powder heat until mustard seeds begin to "pop" then lower the heat a little , add the spinach and salt cover and cook for about 10 minutes , stirring periodically uncover and cook for another 5 minutes voila , ready to serve !

name: Simple and tasty rabbit
ingredients: rabbit|onions|garlic cloves|olive oil|hungarian paprika|ground cumin|ground coriander|salt|water
steps: sautee onions in oil , in a large shallow casserole , until transparent toss in garlic , continue until fragrant place rabbit pieces on top cook , stirring energetically for 3-5 minutes until meat is browned toss in the spices , stir to get everything nicely covered add water simmer , covered , for about 35-40 minutes or until cooked through serve with mashed potatoes , rice or buckwheat

name: Simple and tasty white asparagus
ingredients: lemon|butter|kosher salt|white asparagus
steps: add the lemon juice , butter , and salt to a pot of water and bring to a simmer peel the asparagus and trim the ends simmer until tender (how long this takes will vary with the size of the asparagus so check them frequently)

name: Simple and yummy blueberry scones
ingredients: all-purpose flour|baking powder|salt|sugar|ground allspice|butter|milk|fresh blueberries|heavy cream
steps: first preheat oven to 425f then take out a large baking sheet and grease it set it aside in a large bowl , you will need to combine your flour , baking powder , salt , sugar , and allspice cut your butter into flour mixture with pastry knife making sure to cut it through until it looks crumbly now you will need to make a well in the center of this mixture and add the milk beginning stirring mixture , then add your blueberries , and finish stirring until dough forms if you feel that it is not forming well , you can always add a tiny bit of milk to make it all come together , but be careful not to add much more milk , and do not overwork the dough now you must form the dough into one large round , and flatten it out into a 10 inch disk with a sharp knife , cut the dough into 10 wedges you can do so by cutting it exactly as you would cut a pie ! slide disk of scone wedges on to baking sheet sheet brush tops with cream , and sprinkle sugar over the cream bake scones for 15 minutes , or until golden brown remove from baking sheet when done , and cut the wedges where you made your cuts earlier serve warm with my blueberry sauce or with butter and honey ! you can even eat them plain !

name: Simple antipasto salad the way my mom made it
ingredients: iceberg lettuce|hard salami|tomatoes|part-skim mozzarella cheese|italian dressing
steps: remove outer leaves and wash the iceberg lettuce and pat dry chop and shred the iceberg lettuce and place in large bowl chop the 1 / 4 inch-thick salami slices into bite-sized chunks add to the iceberg chop tomatoes , add to the iceberg sprinkle salad with desired amount of shredded mozzarella cheese when ready to serve , pour over your favorite italian dressing and toss to coat

name: Simple apple bacon saute
ingredients: golden delicious apple|apple-smoked bacon|kosher salt
steps: fry bacon in saute pan until crispy remove bacon from pan and place on paper towel crumble bacon into med size pieces once it's cool enough to handle in same pan add the sliced up apples to hot pan with drippings add a little bit of salt to taste saute for about 6-7 minutes on med to med-high or until apples start to soften stir in bacon and serve warm very good served with pancakes

name: Simple apple butter
ingredients: unsweetened applesauce|sugar|cinnamon|clove|nutmeg|ginger|lemon juice
steps: combine ingredients in a heavy skillet cook over medium-low heat , stirring constantly , until it will not run together when a spoon is drawn through please also be sure to stir constantly because it will scorch if you don't i spoon it into clean , dry freezer jam jars , leaving headspace and then freeze thaw in fridge to use this can be easily doubled

name: Simple apple cake
ingredients: all-purpose flour|baking powder|cinnamon|butter|granulated sugar|eggs|vanilla|golden delicious apples|powdered sugar
steps: peel , core , and thinly slice the apples cream butter , vanilla , eggs , and sugar add cinnamon and baking powder beat in flour stir in apples to combine spoon batter into a greased 9x13 pan smooth top with knife or rubber scraper bake at 350 degrees for 50-60 minutes until golden brown on top let cool for 10 minutes sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired

name: Simple apple crisp
ingredients: apples|cinnamon|nutmeg|water|lemon juice|butter|sugar|flour
steps: pre-heat oven to 350 placed sliced apples in buttered 8x8 pan add spices , lemon juice and water in separate bowl , mix butter , sugar and flour until crumbly sprinkle on top of apples bake for 1 hour or until top is golden brown and apples are tender

name: Simple apple dessert
ingredients: apples|honey|cocoa powder
steps: 1 preheat oven to 375f 2 cut apples into slices 3 lay out some aluminum foil and cover half with a thin layer of honey 4 place apple slices on aluminum foil and pour honey over top 5 sprinkle with a light layer of cocoa powder 6 fold the rest of the aluminum foil over and roll edges 7 bake until apples are softened

name: Simple apple fritters
ingredients: flour|baking powder|sugar|salt|egg|milk|apple|cooking oil|confectioners' sugar
steps: measure and sift all dry ingredients beat eggs and milk together slowly incorporating the dry ingredients add the chopped apples in a heavy skillet on the stovetop , heat cooking oil over medium-high heat drop teaspoon full of apple-batter into hot oil and fry until golden brown in color- 3 to 4 minutes on each side remove from oil and drain on brown paper cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar makes 12 small fritters eliminate the sugar and serve with pork roast

name: Simple apple muffins
ingredients: brown sugar|corn oil|egg|vanilla|flour|baking soda|salt|apple|buttermilk|walnuts|cinnamon
steps: preheat oven to 325-degrees f grease muffin tins or use paper liners in a large bowl , blend 3 / 4 cup brown sugar , oil , egg and vanilla with a wooden spoon add flour , baking soda and salt stir in apple and buttermilk and mix throughly until combined well spoon batter into prepared muffin tins in a small bowl combine remaining 1 / 4 cup brown sugar with remaining ingredients sprinkle over muffins bake for 30-40 minutes or until muffins are browned and toothpick comes clean when inserted in middle

name: Simple apple pie
ingredients: pie shell|apple pie filling|applesauce|flour|brown sugar|old fashioned oats|cinnamon|butter
steps: bake pie shell to the directions it came with let cool mix flour , brown sugar , rolled oats , and cinnamon add butter and mix with hands until crumbly mixture appears put pie filling in shell , top with applesauce filling in so the pie is same level throughout add crumble mixture on top of the pie bake for 25 to 30 minutes , at 325 degrees

name: Simple apple pie spice
ingredients: ground cinnamon|ground nutmeg|ground ginger
steps: combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight-fitting lid shake well to mix uses: add 1 teaspoon per pie stir into applesauce heat with apple cider stir into crumb topping for coffeecake , dutch apple pie , apple crisp

name: Simple apple spice dump cake
ingredients: spice cake mix|apple pie filling|ground cinnamon|ground nutmeg|ground allspice|granulated sugar|butter|nuts
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees f pour the apple pie filling into a 13 x 9-inch baking pan in a small bowl , mix together cinnamon , nutmeg , allspice and sugar sprinkle mixture over pie filling pour dry cake mix over apples dot with butter and sprinkle nuts on top bake at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes to one hour , until cake is brown on top and bubbling on the sides serve warm with ice cream or whipped topping

name: Simple arroz con pollo
ingredients: olive oil|chicken breasts|flour|salt and pepper|chicken stock|instant rice|garlic cloves|onion|diced tomatoes|oregano|hot paprika|saffron thread
steps: in a shallow dish mix flour , salt , pepper and paprika drege the chicken in the flour mixture in a large skillet heat oil and brown chicken on both sides about 5 minutes per side remove the chicken from the oil and keep warm in a mixing bowl combine stock , tomatoes , salt and pepper , saffron and oregano brown rice in the left over oil in the skillet add onion and garlic and saute until onions are translucent place chicken back in skillet and add stock mixture bring to a boil and then let simmer for 10-15 minutes or until rice is fluffy and chicken is cooked all the way through

name: Simple artichoke soup
ingredients: water-packed artichoke hearts|vegetable broth|olive oil|flour|cayenne|ground thyme|garlic powder
steps: drain and rinse the artichokes put artichokes and vegetable broth in blender or food processor and blend until completely liquid warm olive oil in a saucepan on med-high heat add flour and stir constantly until starting to turn brown slowly add the artichoke broth a little bit at a time , stirring constantly so that it doesn't become lumpy add spices to taste cook for 5 minutes serve hot

name: Simple arugula salad
ingredients: pecans|baby arugula|peach|sharp white cheddar cheese|olive oil|red wine vinegar|dijon mustard|honey|kosher salt|fresh ground black pepper
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees f on a rimmed baking sheet , toast pecans , tossing once , until fragrant , 4 to 5 minutes let cool and chop pecans set aside in a serving bowl , toss together arugula , sliced peach , and cheddar whisk together vinaigrette ingredients or place them in a glass jar with a tight fitting lid and give them a good shake drizzle 4 tablespoons of the vinaigrette over salad and scatter pecans on top toss to combine serve with additional vinaigrette , if desired

name: Simple asian lemon chicken
ingredients: oil|chicken breast|frozen asian-style vegetables|red pepper|lemon jell-o gelatin|cornstarch|chicken broth|italian salad dressing|garlic cloves
steps: heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat add chicken , and stir fry for about 4 minutes , or until cooked through add peppers and veggies cook about 2 minutes mix dry jello and cornstarch , in small bowl add broth , dressing , and garlic stir until jello is dissolved add to skillet reduce heat to medium cook about 3 minutes , or until sauce is thickened , stirring frequently serve over hot rice

name: Simple asian marinade for chicken
ingredients: chicken breast fillets|soy sauce|fresh lemon juice|fresh ginger|fresh coriander|scallions
steps: put all ingredients together with chicken breasts and marinade for at least one hour when cooked , throw over sliced green onions for decoration

name: Simple au jus gravy
ingredients: water|beef bouillon|soy sauce|garlic powder|salt and pepper
steps: place the water in a medium sauce pan and bring to a boil reduce heat to low whisk in the beef bouillon whisk in the soy sauce , garlic powder and salt and pepper to taste if you like a thicker au jus gravy , you can also whisk in a little flour to thicken it

name: Simple avgolemono
ingredients: chicken stock|long grain rice|egg yolks|lemon juice|fresh parsley|salt|fresh ground black pepper
steps: bring stock to boil in large saucepan , turn down to a simmer and add the rice , cook for about 12 minutes or until rice is tender , season with salt and pepper whisk the egg yolks together and add half the lemon juice whisk to combine and keep whisking until smooth and bubbly add a ladle of the hot liquid to the egg yolks and whisk inches remove soup from the heat and slowly add the egg mixture , whisking constantly taste the soup and add the other 2 tbsp of lemon juice if necessary , stir in parsley and serve immediately

name: Simple avocado salad
ingredients: avocado|tomatoes|sweet onions|cilantro|olive oil|lime juice|cumin|salt and pepper
steps: slice avocado and tomato into 1 / 4" thick slices arrange on a serving plate , alternating tomato slices with one or two avocado slices scatter with sweet onion and cilantro make dressing by combining olive oil , lime juice , cumin , and salt and pepper and shaking or whisking until well mixed drizzle dressing over avocado and tomato

name: Simple avocado salsa
ingredients: cherry tomatoes|lime juice|avocados|salt|pepper
steps: gently combine all ingredients until the avocadoes and tomatoes are lightly coated with juice serve at room temperature or slightly chilled

name: Simple avocado mango salsa
ingredients: mango|tomatoes|green onions|lime juice|jalapeno pepper|avocado|salt|pepper
steps: combine all ingredients serve with grilled meats or with tortilla chips

name: Simple baby bok choy and snow peas
ingredients: peanut oil|garlic cloves|fresh ginger|baby bok choy|snow peas|chicken stock|oyster sauce|sesame oil
steps: add the oil , garlic and ginger into a wok or large saute pan turn the heat to medium-high as the oil heats , the garlic and ginger will infuse the oil with flavor take care that they do not burn when the oil is hot , add the bok choy and the snow peas and toss to coat them in the oil stir-fry the mixture for about a minute add the stock and oyster sauce and bring to a boil cover and cook for 2 minute until the bok choy stems are crisp-tender drizzle the sesame oil over the mixture and serve

name: Simple bacardi cocktail
ingredients: bacardi light rum|lime juice|simple syrup|grenadine
steps: in a shaker half-filled with ice cubes , combine all of the ingredients shake well strain into a cocktail glass

name: Simple bacon and mushroom pasta
ingredients: olive oil|onion|garlic clove|bacon|tagliatelle pasta noodles|button mushrooms|creme fraiche|salt and pepper
steps: saute the onion , garlic and bacon in the olive oil over a low heat until soft for around 15 minutes , stirring occasionally meanwhile , cook the tagliatelle in a large pan of slightly salted water according to the instructions on the packet drain the pasta in a colander and pour over some boiling water to wash away the starch and prevent the pasta from sticking together stir the mushrooms into the onion and bacon mixture and saute for five minutes stir in the creme fraiche , season to taste and heat through remove from the heat and stir in the cooked tagliatelle serve immediately

name: Simple bacon wrapped stuffed chicken breasts
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|ham|muenster cheese|bacon|pepper
steps: pound 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts until 1 / 4 inch thick season with pepper top each piece with a slice of ham and a slice of muenster cheese wrap them in bundles with 2 strips of bacon for each breast bake in shallow baking dish at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes garnish with parsley

name: Simple bacon cheddar sandwich
ingredients: bacon|scallions|bread|unsalted butter|cheddar cheese
steps: preheat oven to 375 degrees lay bacon in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet and cook until crisp , about 15 to 20 minutes drain on paper towels cool and rinse the pan line the baking sheet with foil trim the root ends of the scallions , halve lengthwise , and chop into about 1-inch pieces lay out the bread on a work surface and butter 1 side of each piece put 4 slices of the bread , buttered side down , on the prepared baking sheet layer half of the cheese slices on the bread layer the bacon and scallions on top of the cheese and cover with the remaining cheese top with the remaining slices of bread buttered side up and bake until each bottom pieces of bread is golden brown , about 10 minutes flip the sandwiches and bake until the other side is golden brown and the cheese has melted , about 8 to 10 minutes more

name: Simple baked alaska
ingredients: ice cream|sponge cakes|egg whites|vanilla|cream of tartar|sugar
steps: lay ice cream bricks side by side measure length and width trim cake 1 inch larger on all sides than ice cream measurements place cake on a piece of foil center ice cream on cake cover freeze till firm at serving time , beat together egg whites , vanilla , and cream of tartar to soft peaks gradually add in sugar beating after each tablespoon is added transfer cake with ice cream to a baking sheet spread with egg white mixture , sealing to edges of cake and baking sheet all around swirl to make peaks place oven rack in lowest position bake in a 500f degrees oven about 3 minutes or till golden slice serve immediately

name: Simple baked apples
ingredients: apples|sugar|cinnamon|nutmeg
steps: preheat oven to 400 f core apples and place in a baking dish blend sugar with spices spoon an equal amunt into each apple cover bottom of baking dish with 1 / 4 inch boiling water bake until soft several times during baking , spoon pan juices over apples

name: Simple baked asparagus
ingredients: fresh asparagus|olive oil|soy sauce|salt and pepper
steps: preheat oven to 350f line a baking pan with foil for easy clean up mix oil and soy sauce and pour onto foil-lined pan prepare fresh asparagus by washing and snapping the ends gently roll the asparagus in the oil and soy mixture sprinkle with salt and pepper roast for 10-15 minutes

name: Simple baked buffalo wings
ingredients: unsalted butter|cayenne pepper sauce|chicken wings|blue cheese dressing|celery rib
steps: heat oven to 350 f combine butter and hot sauce in a small sauce pan heat over medium-low heat until butter is melted stir to combine place chicken pieces on a broiler pan brush generously with sauce bake for 15 minutes brush with sauce , turn , and brush other side with sauce bake for another 15 minutes turn oven up to 400 f brush chicken , turn , and brush again bake 15 minutes brush , turn , and brush other side with remaining sauce bake 10 minutes , then turn once more and bake for another 5 minutes serve hot with celery sticks and blue cheese dressing

name: Simple baked chicken
ingredients: whole chickens|water|butter|onion|celery rib|seasoning salt
steps: pour water in 8 inch baking dish rinse chicken and then coat with butter holding chicken up , sprinkle all over with seasoned salt place chicken in baking dish , top with any extra seasoned salt put celery and onion in chicken's"cavity" cover with aluminum foil and bake for at least 1 hour at 350 degrees uncover and bake an additional 10 to 15 minutes for chicken to"brown" lightly

name: Simple baked chicken breast fillets
ingredients: chicken breast fillets|butter|seasoning salt|black pepper|cooking spray
steps: preheat oven to 350' wash chicken fillets and pat dry in a baking dish , spray pam well place chicken fillets in baking dish sprinkle top and bottom with seasoning salt and black pepper , to your own taste add 1tbs of butter to each chicken fillet , using up the amount of butter stated place in oven and bake 30-45 minutes , or until no longer pink serve either as a main meat or as a chicken sandwich

name: Simple baked chicken drumsticks
ingredients: chicken drumsticks|garlic powder|pepper|salt|olive oil|rosemary|parsley
steps: put some olive oil in the bottom of a 9x13 pan add drumsticks sprinkle generously with pepper and garlic powder sprinkle lightly with salt add rosemary to the chicken , if desired bake at 375 f for half an hour turn drumsticks over and add more garlic powder , pepper and salt top with the parsley bake another half an hour , or until cooked until 160f

name: Simple baked chicken wings
ingredients: chicken wings|onion powder|season salt|paprika|pepper|barbecue sauce
steps: rub seasonings onto both sides of individual chicken wings place in glass casserole dish bake at 350f for 30 minutes take out of oven and coat both sides of wings with barbecue sauce bake for another 7 minutes , flip wings bake for another 7 minutes , flip wings bake for another 7 minutes , flip wings enjoy !

name: Simple baked cod or haddock
ingredients: whole grain mustard|parmesan cheese|breadcrumbs|olive oil|parsley|cod|tomatoes|salt and pepper|white wine
steps: preheat oven to 190c / 375f in a small bowl , mix together the mustard , parmesan , breadcrumbs , olive oil and parsley and set aside lay the cod pieces in a baking dish , flesh side up spread the mustard mixture evenly over each piece of cod sprinkle the chopped tomato over each piece season with salt and pepper pour the wine or stock around cod bake for 10-12 minutes or until fish flakes

name: Simple baked crispy coconut chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|buttermilk|panko breadcrumbs|coconut|salt|pepper
steps: put breasts and buttermilk in a ziplock and marinate 30 minutes or more in another bag mix crumbs , coconut , salt and pepper place breasts one at a time in crumb mixture and coat thoroughly , pressing cumb mixture onto both sides place chicken in heavily greased baking pan sprinkle remaining crumb mix evenly over tops and spray heavily with pan spray bake 400 f for 15-20 minute make ahead put chicken and buttermilk in one ziplock crumb mixture in another package together in the freezer

name: Simple baked curry chicken with cling peaches
ingredients: flour|paprika|chicken parts|vegetable oil|curry powder|salt|cream of chicken soup|water|peach slices|celery top
steps: combine flour and paprika coat chicken well brown chicken , on all sides , in oil in a skillet drain excess oil sprinkle with curry powder and salt blend soup with 1 cup water and pour over the chicken in the skillet bring to a boil place the chicken mixture in a casserole dish and cover and bake in a 325 degree oven for 1 hour or until chicken is tender add peach slices and heat through garnish with celery tops

name: Simple baked eggs ramekin baked eggs
ingredients: butter|eggs|fresh ground black pepper|salt|whipping cream
steps: preheat oven to 350 coat each of 6 ramekins or custard cups with 1 / 2 teaspoon butter break 1 egg into each prepared ramekin sprinkle eggs evenly with pepper and salt spoon 1 teaspoon cream over each egg place ramekins in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish add hot water to pan to a depth of 1 1 / 4 inches bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until eggs are set

name: Simple baked fiori
ingredients: pasta|nonstick cooking spray|garlic|lean ground beef|dried thyme|dried oregano|dried rosemary|salt|black pepper|diced tomatoes|cheddar cheese
steps: preheat your oven to 350 degrees f cook the pasta according to the directions on the box drain and set aside spray a medium sized saucepan with the cooking spray , or if you want you can use a tsp of olive oil add the minced garlic and cook for a minute or so over medium heat add the ground beef and cook until browned , breaking up the meat as it cooks , and drain the liquids keep the pan at medium heat add the thyme , oregano , rosemary , salt and pepper stir to coat the beef , and cook for another minute or so add the tomatoes and bring the mixture to a boil then , reduce the heat and let the mixture simmer for 5 minutes spoon a small amount of the mixture into the bottom of a 4- quart casserole dish top with half of the cooked pasta , and then layer half of the tomato mixture over the pasta , then layer half of the cheese layer the remaining pasta on top , and top the pasta with the remaining sauce and cheese i always just use enough cheese to make each layer , so it is probably going to be more than the 1 cup cover the dish with foil and bake until the cheese is golden and bubbly , about 30 minutes enjoy !

name: Simple baked fish
ingredients: tilapia fillet|butter|lemon juice|garlic clove|sugar|pepper|thyme|parsley|breadcrumbs
steps: preheat oven to 425 lightly grease or spray a 13" x 9" baking dish rinse fish filets and pat dry set them in a single layer in the prepared baking dish in a small bowl , combine melted butter , lemon juice , garlic , sugar , pepper , thyme and parsley stir well pour evenly over fish filets sprinkle with the breadcrumbs bake at 425 for about 20 minutes or until filets are opaque and flakey

name: Simple baked fish in foil ww
ingredients: fish fillets|sweet onion|olive oil|butter|lemon pepper|lemon slices
steps: place sliced onion rings on aluminum foil , place filets on top , drizzle with oil and butter and sprinkle on seasoniing , top with lemon slices wrap tightly , bake or grill at 350 degress for about 20 minute or until fish flakes serve with fresh lemon if desired

name: Simple baked french toast
ingredients: italian bread|unsalted butter|eggs|whole milk|salt|sugar|pure maple syrup
steps: butter a 13-by-9-inch glass baking dish cut twelve 1-inch-thick diagonal slices from bread generously butter one side of each slice and arrange slices buttered sides up in one layer in buttered dish , squeezing them slightly to fit if necessary whisk together eggs , milk , and salt in a bowl until well combined , then pour evenly over bread refrigerate , covered , until bread has absorbed all of custard , at least 1 hour put a rack in middle of oven and preheat oven to 425f bring soaked bread to room temperature sprinkle bread with sugar bake until bread is puffed and top is golden , 20 to 25 minutes serve immediately , with maple syrup cook's the soaked bread can be refrigerated for up to 24 hours cook time does not include refrigeration or bringing the bread back to room temperature before cooking

name: Simple baked ham
ingredients: ham|brown sugar|ground cloves|prepared mustard
steps: boil the ham for 1 / 2 hour per lb make sure the water covers at least 3 / 4 of the height of the ham after it is properly boiled , lay the meat in an appropriate roaster cut some grooves along the top of the ham and then pour the sauce mixture on put in the oven for 1 / 2 hour at 375 f , uncovered

name: Simple baked mostaccioli
ingredients: spaghetti sauce with meat|mostaccioli noodles|small curd cottage cheese|mozzarella cheese
steps: preheat oven to 350f mix all ingrdients in a casserole dish , cover with mozzarella bake , covered if your cheese is browning too quickly , until browned and bubbily and heated through

name: Simple baked oatmeal lower fat
ingredients: brown sugar|oil|unsweetened applesauce|eggs|vanilla|rice milk|water|rolled oats|oat bran|ground flax seeds|baking powder|salt|cinnamon|chocolate chips
steps: preheat oven to 350 in a medium bowl , mix the sugar , oil , applesauce , eggs , vanilla , milk and water in a separate bowl , mix the oats , oat bran , flax , baking powder , salt and cinnamon add the dry to the wet , mix thoroughly , then fold in the chocolate chips or fruit , if using pour into a greased 9x13 pan and bake for 35-40 minutes , until golden on the edges

name: Simple baked potato wedges
ingredients: potatoes|olive oil|mrs. dash seasoning mix
steps: wash potatoes , but do not peel slice lengthwise into wedges and put into large bowl of cold water drain water from bowl pour olive oil over wedges and stir well to coat sprinkle mrs dash seasoning over potatoes to taste and stir well to blend line large cookie sheet with aluminum foil spread potato wedges in single layer on cookie sheet bake at 375 degrees for an hour or until wedges are tender serve hot

name: Simple baked soy sauce garlic chicken wings
ingredients: chicken wings|light soy sauce|garlic|fresh ground black pepper|cayenne pepper|jasmine rice
steps: grab a big bowl place chicken wings in bowl coat wings with soy sauce , leaving a little puddle for them to marinate in on the bottom press the garlic through a garlic press & scatter around grind about a teaspoon of black pepper on top throw in some cayenne if you're feeling daring , i just eyeball it cook some jasmine rice in the rice cooker , the chicken is great with it ! but can also be made alone i get mahatma jasmine rice at the grocery store , nice and cheap ! marinate for at least 2 hours , but keep in mind the longer it marinates the tastier the wings will be i like to prep it before bed and cook it the next day for dinner perfect ! after marinating , preheat the oven @ 375 degrees & pop the wings in , after 30 minutes turn them over and let cook for another 30 minutes and voila ! dinner is served :)

name: Simple baked tofu
ingredients: firm tofu|soy sauce|balsamic vinegar|garlic powder|ground ginger|salt|white pepper|olive oil
steps: cube tofu mix all ingredients into a large bowl let marinade in the fridge for about one hour preheat oven to 350 place tofu on a cooling rack with a baking pan underneath to catch excess liquid bake for 10 minutes , turn tofu and bake for another 15 minutes , or until the edges start to brown

name: Simple baklava giada de laurentiis
ingredients: almonds|walnuts|dried apricot|plain breadcrumbs|sugar|ground cinnamon|ground cloves|salt|butter|honey|phyllo dough
steps: preheat the oven to 350 degrees f place the almonds , walnuts , apricots , bread crumbs , sugar , cinnamon , ground cloves , and salt in a food processor run the machine until the mixture is very finely chopped transfer the mixture to a small bowl add 2 tablespoons of the melted butter and the honey and stir to combine on a dry work surface place 1 sheet of phyllo using a pastry brush and the remaining melted butter , lightly cover the entire sheet of phyllo with melted butter cover the first sheet with a second sheet of phyllo and brush with melted butter continue until there is a stack of 6 sheets of phyllo cut the stacked phyllo rectangle into 12 equal pieces gently press each cut piece of phyllo into the mini-muffin tin cups press 1 tablespoon of the nut mixture into each of the phyllo cups gather the ends of each of the phyllo squares and twist to make a sachet shape continue shaping the remaining sachets in the other mini-muffin tin bake until the edges of the phyllo are golden , about 20 to 25 minutes when cool enough to handle , remove the baklava sachets and transfer to a serving plate

name: Simple balsamic tuna and triscuits
ingredients: reduced-fat triscuit|light chunk tuna in water|extra virgin olive oil|balsamic vinegar|dried oregano|black pepper|salt
steps: drain tuna well and transfer to a medium-sized mixing bowl combine with oil and vinegar mix in the spices and serve on or with triscuits can be served directly out of mixing bowl using triscuits as a scooping agent , if this is just for yourself and you're in a hurry you could also dollop the tuna on to the triscuits , where they would be acting as little edible plates in this instance if you want to serve them hot , drizzle the triscuits with olive oil before placing them on a baking sheet , then topping them with mozzarella cheese and a touch more oregano bake for 7 minutes in a 375 degree oven recipe can easily be doubled or tripled with mul

name: Simple balsamic vinaigrette
ingredients: balsamic vinegar|fresh oregano|salt|fresh ground black pepper|olive oil
steps: in a small bowl , combine vinegar and seasonings gradually whisk in olive oil to blend serve over your favorite salad greens especially nice garnished with shaved parmesan cheese refrigerate any unused vinaigrette

name: Simple banana bread
ingredients: flour|baking soda|eggs|oil|sugar|bananas
steps: preheat oven to 350f mix flour and baking soda in a seperate bowl , beat eggs with fork add oil , sugar and bananas add flour mixture , stir until well blended pour into greased loaf pan bake for 1 hour

name: Simple banana chocolate chip bread
ingredients: bananas|eggs|flour|sugar|salt|baking soda|chocolate chips
steps: preheat oven to 350f with the rack in the center position butter and flour a 6-cup loaf pan mash bananas in a large bowl add eggs and mix well sift the flour , sugar , salt , and baking soda into the bowl and mix well stir in chocolate pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean turn out the loaf onto a wire rack to cool

name: Simple banana nut bread
ingredients: crisco|eggs|banana|sugar|nuts|flour|baking powder|salt|baking soda
steps: preheat oven to 350 grease a medium sized loaf pan for single recipe pour batter in pan and bang on counter a few times to release any air bake about 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean

name: Simple banana apple bread
ingredients: flour|baking soda|salt|sugar|eggs|vegetable oil|milk|bananas|nuts|apple
steps: mix together flour , baking soda , salt , and sugar blend in eggs , oil , and milk stir in banana , apple , and nuts pour batter into greased loaf pan bake at 350 degrees for about 1 hour or until toothpick test comes out clean

name: Simple barbecue sauce
ingredients: oil|garlic clove|chili powder|ketchup|apple cider vinegar|brown sugar|worcestershire sauce
steps: heat oil saute garlic add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil simmer for 15 minutes

name: Simple barley casserole
ingredients: barley|onion|butter|chicken broth|salsa|salt|pepper
steps: pre heat oven to 350 f degrees melt butter in a pan and saute onion and barley until toasted then put in a casserole dish add everything else and cook 1 hour covered uncover , and bake 20 more minutes or until liquid is gone

name: Simple basic unbaked cheesecake with variations
ingredients: butter|biscuits|cream cheese|caster sugar|heavy cream
steps: base: in a food processor or blender combine the biscuits and melted butter until fine crumbs press the crumbs evenly and firmly into a 23cm round springform tin or one with a removable base smooth with a spoon and place in fridge filling: beat the cream cheese for a few mins on low speed with an electric beater until soft and lump free slowly add the sugar while continuing to beat on low once the sugar is incorporated slowly pour in the cream while still beating on low on a higher speed whip the cream cheese & cream mixture til it holds its shape completely when the beater passes through the mix and it looks a little grainy spoon into the chilled base and smooth with a spatula chill for at least 4hours or overnight remove from tin and place on serving dish cut into portions using a hot dry knife between each slice , clean & reheat knife by dipping into hot water & drying this makes neater portions variation #1 rippled jelly cheesecake: make a basic cheesecake and place in fridge while you prepare jelly place 250mls water , 90g raspberries or other berries and 3tblsp sugar into a pot and simmer for 2mins when cooled a little , puree in a blender until smooth and return to clean pot on the stove and over a low heat stir in 1tsp gelatine until dissolved pass the mixture through a fine sieve into a metal bowl and chill until it reaches a thick soup like consistency pour this over the chilled cheesecake and use a fork to fold in the jelly by working in circles when the jelly is partially worked in , tap the tin on the bench until the surface flattens , then place in fridge for at least 4hrs to set variation #2: chocolate chip cheesecake make basic cheesecake using either plain or chocolate biscuits for base melt 120g dark chocolate , then squiggle onto the surface of made cheesecake before chilling using a fork , quickly work circles of chocolate through the cheesecake the chocolate will set while you are doing this tap the tin on the bench to settle & flatten the surface then chill for 4hrs or overnight for a real treat you can use both the jelly and chocolate in the one cheesecake to make it a "rippled jelly & chocolate chip cheesecake :)

name: Simple basic quiche
ingredients: shortcrust pastry|eggs|onion|tomatoes|green pepper|cheddar cheese|salt and pepper
steps: finely chop onion , green pepper and tomatoes whisk 3 eggs grate the cheese add all ingredients to egg mixture place in pastry case leave in oven for 30 minutes or until lightly browned on top

name: Simple basil sauce for two
ingredients: mayonnaise|dried basil|lemon juice|black pepper
steps: in a small dish , add mayo , basil and lemon juice - mix well serve alongside fish , or on a baked potato , or as dip for vegetables

name: Simple batter for fish or veggies
ingredients: flour|milk|egg
steps: mix all ingredients together dip food into batter and fry as desired

name: Simple bbq chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken thighs|water|barbecue sauce|pepsi
steps: simmer chicken in water , so it cooks without sticking to pan not too much water , or you will boil the chicken instead of sauteeing it once chicken is half cooked , place on simmer and heavily brush with bbq sauce add a little bit of soda , so the chicken does not stick to pan once soda is cooked away , turn the chicken and repeat with the other side do this several times until you have a good coating of bbq sauce on the chicken and there is a bit of sauce left in the pan if chicken is frozen or has bone in it , it takes longer to cook be sure chicken is cooked through by using meat thermometer sauce may burn , so be sure to cook this over low heat

name: Simple bbq sauce
ingredients: catsup|water|diced onion|vinegar|brown sugar|worcestershire sauce|steak spice|cayenne pepper
steps: in medium heavy saucepan combine all ingredients bring to a boil , stirring constantly , reduce heat simmer uncovered for 10 to 15 minutes or until thickened to desired consistency to store , place in airtight glass container in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks

name: Simple bean dip
ingredients: refried beans|nacho cheese soup|salsa|green onion
steps: in a large pot combine beans , soup , and salsa cook for about 30 minutes or until well mixed sprinkle with green onions and serve with tortilla chips !

name: Simple bean soup with ham bone
ingredients: navy beans|water|ham bone|celery|onion|carrots|salt|pepper
steps: simmer beans in water with ham bone for 2 hours add other ingredients , simmer 2 hours , until beans are tender remove meat from bone , discard bone

name: Simple beans and rice stuffed bell peppers
ingredients: red peppers|black bean and rice mix|old cheddar cheese|condensed tomato soup
steps: prepare beans and rice according to package directions let stand until most of the liquid is absorbed preheat oven to 350 degrees wash and dry peppers slice off the stem end and remove membrane and seeds stuff each pepper halfway with beans and rice , sprinkle in 1 / 4 of the cheese , fill to the top with beans and rice and sprinkle in another 1 / 4 of the cheese press with the back of a spoon as you fill to compact replace the stem ends onto the peppers stand up in an ovenproof baking dish and spoon tomato soup over do not reconstitute the soup bake for 40 - 50 minutes , until peppers are tender use a couple of toothpicks to hold the stem "lid" in place prep time doesn't include time to make the beans and rice - 25 minutes

name: Simple beef and barley soup
ingredients: beef short rib|oxtails|boneless chuck roast|vegetable oil|whole tomatoes|carrot|quick-cooking barley|water|beef bouillon cubes
steps: in a large heavy stockpot or dutch oven , heat oil until shimmering brown beef on all sides brown meat in small groups to prevent crowding , therefore steaming the meat remove meat from pot and discard oil when all the meat is browned , keeping the brown bits on the bottom of the pot put the browned beef back in the pot and add 8 c water add bouillon cubes and bring to a boil cover and simmer until the meat falls off the bone , 2-3 hours , depending on your meat and heat at this point , you should decide if you are serving the soup that day or the next if you are serving the soup that day: pull out the meat and skim off any gunk on the surface when meat is cool enough to handle , discard the bones and obvious fat add meat back to soup check for beef flavor of the soup if not beefy enough , add another bouillon cube add the barley , carrots and tomatoes add salt to taste and cook until carrots are just tender , about 1 / 2 hour on a simmer you can also add a squirt of ketchup if you wish if you are preparing the soup for the next day : remove the meat and refrigerate strain soup to remove any unwanted bits , cover and refrigerate the next day , about 1 hour before serving , remove the fat layer from the top of the soup begin to heat soup , over medium heat remove meat from the bones and add back to soup add carrots , tomatoes and barley add another bouillon cube if the soup is not beefy enough simmer until carrots are tender for 1 / 2 - 1 hour add salt to taste you can also add a squirt of ketchup if you wish serve soup with noodles

name: Simple beef broccoli
ingredients: round steaks|broccoli|soy sauce|cornstarch|sugar|vegetable oil|accent seasoning|water|salt and pepper
steps: combine all marinade ingredients in a medium zip-top bag add sliced meat , and mix well place in fridge to marinate for 30 minutes or longer meanwhile , slice broccoli diagonally into small pieces heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet stir fry broccoli in oil sprinkle lightly with sugar while cooking broccoli will be done in about 1-2 minutes remove broccoli from heat stir fry meat in same pan until cooked through combine all gravy ingredients , and add to meat cook until slightly thickened add broccoli and heat through serve over hot , cooked rice

name: Simple beef chili with kidney beans
ingredients: vegetable oil|onions|red bell pepper|garlic cloves|chili powder|ground cumin|ground coriander|red pepper flakes|dried oregano|cayenne pepper|lean ground beef|red kidney beans|tomatoes|tomato puree|table salt|limes
steps: heat oil in large heavy-bottomed non-reactive dutch oven over medium heat until shimmering but not smokng , 3-4 minutes add onions , bell pepper , garlic , cumin , coriander pepper flakes , oregano , and cayenne cook , stirring occasionally , until vegetables are softened and beginning to brown , about 10 minutes increase heat to medium-high and add half the beef cook , breaking up pieces with wooden spoon , until no longer pink and just beginning to brown , 3-4 minutes add remainng beef and cook , breaking up pieces with wooden spoon until no longer pink , 3-4 minutes add beans , tomatoes , tomato puree , and 1 / 2 teaspoons salt bring to a boil , then reduce heat to low and simmer , covered , stirring occasionally , for 1 hour remove cover and continue to simmer 1 hour longer , stirring occasionally , until beef is tender and chili is dark , rich , and slightly thickened adjust seasoning with additional salt serve with lime wedges and condiments if desired slow cooker option: at the end of step 1 , transfer the cooked beef mixture to a slow cooker add the rest of the ingredients as directed in step 2 cook the chili on high for 4 hours

name: Simple beef curry
ingredients: stewing beef|canola oil|onion|garlic cloves|curry powder|paprika|chili powder|salt|water|cilantro|parsley
steps: heat the oil over medium heat and saute the onion for about 3 minutes , or until translucent add the garlic , curry , paprika , chili powder and salt cook , stirring constantly , for about 3 minutes add the beef and stir add 1 / 2 cup water and bring to a medium simmer cover , and cook for about five minutes add enough water to cover the beef and cover once again cook for 1-2 hours , or until meat is tender and the sauce is thick serve over rice and garnish with the parsley or the cilantro

name: Simple beef stew
ingredients: stewing beef|flour|vegetable oil|onions|celery|fresh parsley|carrots|potatoes|garlic clove|bay leaf|dried thyme|dried oregano|barley|salt|fresh ground pepper
steps: coat meat with flour sear on all sides in oil put onions in pan and brown them put seared meat , browned onions , and all other ingredients in a large pot along with enough water just to cover simmer slowly on low heat at least 2 hours the longer this stew cooks , the better it is

name: Simple beef stew crock pot
ingredients: flour|garlic salt|celery salt|onion powder|parsley|olive oil|beef|baby carrots|potatoes|onion|frozen peas and corn|celery|beef gravy|water
steps: combine garlic salt , celery salt , onion powder , parsley and flour in a large bowl cover the chopped beef with the mixture in a frypan , brown the beef using olive oil , then transfer into the crockpot layer potatoes , carrots , onion , peas , celery , and corn in the crockpot pour beef gravy and water over the stew mixture cook on low for 8 to 10 hours stir occasionally salt and pepper to taste

name: Simple beef stock a la julia child
ingredients: beef bones|carrots|onions|celery|leeks|thyme|fresh bay leaves|garlic cloves|cloves|peppercorns
steps: place the beef bones in a large heavy pot and cover with cold water by about two inches bring to a simmer over medium heat and skim the sum which rises to the top--this should take about five minutes add the remaining ingredients and more cold water so that everything is covered by at least an inch or two bring the stock to a simmer again , skimming as necessary when the stock is simmering , partially cover and maintain at a very slow simmer for four to five hours if the water level gets too low , add boiling water to the pot skim as necessary when the vegetables and the bones have given their all to the broth , strain the broth and discard the solids set the stock , uncovered in the refrigerator until the fat has risen to the top and solidified remove and discard the fat taste the degreased stock and if it is not strong enough , reduce it over medium heat when the stock is cold , store in the refrigerator for up to three days or in the freezer

name: Simple beef stroganoff
ingredients: egg noodles|ground beef|fat-free cream of mushroom soup|garlic powder|sour cream|salt and pepper
steps: prepare the egg noodles according to package directions and set aside in a separate large skillet over medium heat , saute the ground beef over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes , or until browned drain the fat and add the soup and garlic powder simmer for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally remove from heat and combine the meat mixture with the egg noodles add the sour cream , stirring well , and season with salt and pepper to taste

name: Simple beef taquitos
ingredients: vegetable oil|onion|garlic clove|lean ground beef|salsa|chili powder|salt|pepper|flour tortillas|cheddar cheese|sour cream
steps: heat the oven to 400 heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat add the onion and garlic and cook them for 3 minutes , stirring often add the beef and use a wooden spoon or a spatula to break it up while it cooks , until it is no longer red , about 3 minutes stir in 1 / 2 cup of the salsa , the chili powder , and the salt and pepper cook the mixture over low heat , stirring occasionally , for 10 minutes place the tortillas on a plate and cover them with damp paper towels microwave them until warm and pliable , about 45 seconds top each tortilla with 1 / 4 cup of the beef mixture , spreading it to an inch from the edges sprinkle cheese evenly over the beef roll up the tortillas and place them on a foil-lined baking sheet with the seam sides down brush the taquitos lightly with vegetable oil , then bake them until the filling is heated through and the tortillas are lightly browned , about 8 to 12 minutes serve them hot with sour cream and / or salsa

name: Simple beef tips and gravy
ingredients: beef sirloin tip|condensed cream of mushroom soup|condensed cream of chicken soup|brown gravy mix|salt and pepper
steps: in medium saucepan boil drain in medium saucepan or crockpot , add your soups and brown gravy mix , mix well add in broth until gravy is as thick as you like , it will thicken slightly add your serve over rice , noodles , potatoes , your choice !

name: Simple beet pickles
ingredients: beet|white vinegar|white sugar|salt|powdered allspice
steps: cook beets , cool and peel prepare solution put beets in jars pour solution over beets seal jars

name: Simple berry crisp
ingredients: berries|sugar|flour|granola cereal|butter|vanilla yogurt
steps: preheat oven to 375f in a large bowl , gently toss together berries , sugar and flour then transfer to an ungreased baking dish set aside in a medium bowl , toss together granola and butter then scatter over berries in dish bake until top is golden brown and berries and their juices are bubbly , about 30 minutes let cool then spoon into dishes and serve with yogurt or ice cream on top

name: Simple berry smoothie
ingredients: frozen blueberries|nonfat vanilla yogurt|skim milk
steps: blend all ingredients together

name: Simple bird nest
ingredients: egg|bread|salt
steps: turn a small cup open side down use it to cut a hole in the bread fry it in a medium hot pan and toast for a few seconds on stove crack the egg into the hole let it cook 2mins on one side flip it cook it for another minute if you don't like a soft center , cook it for another minute or two i personally like to dip my bread in the egg !

name: Simple biscuits lactose free egg free
ingredients: flour|baking powder|salt|margarine|goat's milk
steps: sift flour , baking powder , and salt into bowl mix butter in with knife or fingers after butter is well mixed , add milk slowly roll dough out on floured board cut with biscuit cutter or cookie cutters bake on greased baking sheet in oven for 10 minutes

name: Simple black bean soup
ingredients: dried black beans|water|beef broth|smoked ham hock|salt|pepper|onion powder|garlic powder|ground red pepper
steps: rinse and sort the beans cover them with several inches of water and soak overnight drain the beans and put in large pot add the water , broth and ham hock bring to a boil then turn down to a simmer simmer for about 2 hours add additional water if beans become visible remove ham hock and let cool just until you can safely handle it remove the skin from the ham hock and discard finely dice the meat and discard the bone puree about half the beans in a blender or with a emulsion blender return the pureed beans to the pot and add the diced ham add seasonings and taste adjust if needed

name: Simple black beans
ingredients: onion|garlic cloves|olive oil|fresh thyme|dried black beans|bay leaves|salt and pepper
steps: in a large pot , saute onion in oil over medium-high heat until the onion is soft , about 5 minutes add the garlic and thyme cook until fragrant , 1 minute add the drained beans , bay leaves and enough water to cover beans bring to a boil over high heat , reduce temperature to simmer , cover and cook for 40 to 50 minutes or until beans are tender but not mushy check often and add from 1 to 2 cups additional water if beans start to cook dry drain beans , remove the bay leaves and fresh thyme springs , season with salt and pepper to taste please if they are salted before they will not soften when cool , divide into 1 cup servings and freeze in rigid container or vacuum pack in small bags

name: Simple blackberry and apple pie
ingredients: shortcrust pastry|cooking apples|blackberries|sugar|milk|water
steps: peel apples , and cut into thick slices place in saucepan , adding enough water to cover and add the sugar simmer for a few minutes until the apples are just cooked but still a bit firm in the centre drain and set to one side to cool heat the oven to 220c roll out the pastry place nearly all of the applies in a pie dish scattering the blackberries evenly over the top sprinkle a dessert spoon of sugar over the berries , then place a layer of apple over that -- this is to stop the stain of the berries going through the pastry add the pastry and brush with a small amount of milk and drizzle a teaspoon or so of sugar over bake for about 30-35 minutes , until pastry is a light golden color i make this pie with minimum pastry and replace the sugar with splenda for my cousin who is diabetic serve hot or cold with either , light cream or ice cream

name: Simple blackened chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|italian salad dressing|minced garlic clove|blackening seasoning
steps: marinate chicken overnight in italian dressing and garlic i like to make sure they are no more than 1" thick , but that's just me heat non-stick skillet for at least 2 minutes on high heat place chicken in single layer on hot skillet add seasoning , quickly flip over and add to other side as well cook until 165 or until white and flaky in the middle of the thickest piece and somewhat black on the outside

name: Simple bliss relaxing tea single serving
ingredients: dried chamomile|boiling water|soymilk|sugar
steps: pour boiling water over the chamomile flowers let steep for 15-20 minutes , until strong at this point it may be a little cold , so i would reheat it in a saucepan or for a few seconds in the microwave i find that reheating once the milk has been added gives teas / coffee a funny taste , so i usually make sure to reheat before i add the milk , but its really up to you strain and add milk and sweetener to taste and serve hot

name: Simple blue cheese dip for the blue cheese lover
ingredients: blue cheese|cottage cheese|milk
steps: remove rind from the cheese in a medium size deep bowl break the cheese into pieces add milk and cottage cheese blend with a hand blender until smooth if consistency is too dense , add more milk and blend again if it's too runny , add more cheese- the proportions are not rigid

name: Simple blue lagoon margaritas
ingredients: lime slices|coarse sugar|carbonated lemon-lime beverage|tequila|frozen limeade concentrate|blue curacao|ice cubes
steps: using lime slices , moisten the rims of four margarita or cocktail glasses set aside lime slices for garnish sprinkle coarse sugar on a plate hold each glass upside down and dip rim into sugar set aside discard remaining sugar on plate in a blender , combine the remaining ingredients cover and process until blended pour into prepared glasses garnish with reservedlime slices serve immediately

name: Simple blueberry muffins
ingredients: whole wheat flour|all-purpose flour|sugar|salt|baking powder|soymilk|applesauce|frozen blueberries
steps: preheat oven to 400f place baking cups in a muffin pan combine flour , sugar , salt , and baking powder together in a mixing bowl add soy milk and apple sauce mix fold in blueberries pour into baking cups and bake for 25-30 minutes

name: Simple boil and bake crispy chicken wings
ingredients: chicken wings|barbecue sauce
steps: boil wings in a large pot of water for about 15 minutes broil wings in oven for about 5-10 minutes per side depending on how your oven works) until nicely browned and crisp i put the bbq sauce in the bottom of a big metal bowl and keep it on the stove near the oven vent so that is warms up a bit remove the wings from the oven and pat with paper towels to remove more grease if necessary toss wings in bowl with bbq sauce until well covered

name: Simple bolognese pasta
ingredients: ground beef|onion|garlic|olive oil|crushed tomatoes|tomato sauce|dried oregano|dried basil|dried parsley|italian salad dressing|salt & pepper|spaghetti
steps: in large skillet pan , heat olive oil add garlic and onion cook 2-3 minutes add ground beef , basil , salt , pepper , oregano , and parsley cook meat until brown drain off any additional fat from pan add italian salad dressing , tomatoes and tomato sauce to skillet pan cook for 4-5minutes until sauce starts to thicken add cooked pasta to sauce for 1-2 minute , then serve add cheese if you desire

name: Simple borscht
ingredients: butter|beetroot|onion|carrot|garlic cloves|caster sugar|beef stock|salt and pepper|lemon, juice of
steps: melt butter in a large pan over a gentle heat and slowly sweat the beet root , onion , carrot and garlic , turning the vegetables over in the butter add the sugar and stock to the pan , season with a few grinds of pepper , bring the soup to a simmer and cook for about 40 minutes until the vegetables are tender using a blender , blend the soup until it is entirely smooth , then add the lemon juice and salt to taste

name: Simple braised carnitas
ingredients: onion|garlic cloves|boneless pork butt|chili powder|kosher salt|black pepper|vegetable oil
steps: cut pork butt into 1 inch cubes and place in a wide pan barely cover the the pork with water or low sodium vegetable stock and bring to a boil turn heat down to medium-low and cook until all liquid is gone turn heat back up to medium-high and fry pork until fat has melted and pork has browned remove pork heat vegetable oil in pan add onions and saute until translucent add garlic and chili powder , cooking for 60 seconds add reserved pork season to taste serve with yellow rice or rolled in a corn or flour tortilla

name: Simple braised chicken
ingredients: chicken thighs|garlic cloves|vegetable oil|mushrooms|sherry wine|soy sauce
steps: in a skillet , brown chicken and garlic lightly in the oil add mushrooms , cover and cook 5 minutes add sherry , cook uncovered until liquid is almost entirely absorbed add soy sauce , cover and cook gently 20 minutes or until chicken is tender

name: Simple bran muffins
ingredients: bran flakes|milk|golden syrup|egg|flour|sultana|salt|sugar|baking soda
steps: soak bran , milk and golden syrup together for 5 minutes mix in all other ingredients preheat oven , and bake for 20 minutes at 180 degrees celcius

name: Simple brandy
ingredients: sugar|vodka|crabapples
steps: enough fruit to somewhat fill a gallon jar , place fruit , any kind , into glass jar -- pits and all , just cut off the yucky parts add sugar and vodka set on your kitchen counter and flip it every day for three months the first few days i place the jar into a bucket in case my lid leaks , that way i can pour it back in and go hunt for a new lid i put a sticker on it indicating the date it will be ready and "up on even" if i happen to start it on an even day , you wouldn't believe how many times i've thought to myself "did i turn the brandy today ? ") in three months strain it through cheesecloth or a clean dishcloth or what have you , if you want it even clearer then strain it again through a paper coffee filter bottle it and wowee it's delicious ! i do up a nice label on my computer and bottle it into smaller than micky bottles to tuck into my christmas baskets

name: Simple brandy cream
ingredients: heavy cream|icing sugar|brandy
steps: whip cream & icing sugar together until soft peaks form then quickly fold in the brandy serve with dessert of your choice

name: Simple bratwurst
ingredients: bratwursts|beer|mustard|sauerkraut|french rolls
steps: place brats and beer in saucepan , making sure that the sausages are covered bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer about 10 minutes or until the brats look done in the meantime , you should fire up the grill charcoal , of course , is best but not always practical also in the meantime , take some aluminum foil and fold it into a packet remove sauerkraut from can / jar with a fork and place into packet seal tightly ! put brats and packet on grill ) grill , turning occasionally , about 8-10 minutes over medium high heat i , personally , like mine with a nice black burnt crust , but i am odd so go with what looks right you want them brown and shiny with wee grill marks on them during the last 2-3 minutes of cooking , place buns , slightly open , with opening down , on grill to toast them serve with mustard and the sauerkraut thou shalt not eat thy brat with ketchup 'tis a mortal sin quaff the rest of the beer

name: Simple bread pudding
ingredients: bread|eggs|milk|butter|sugar|cinnamon
steps: place bread cubes in a 1-1 / 2 qt casserole dish mix together remaining ingredients and pour over bread bake@ 350 for 40-45 minutes enjoy !

name: Simple breaded chicken drumsticks
ingredients: chicken drumsticks|olive oil|italian breadcrumbs|eggs
steps: preheat your oven to 425 degrees with a rack in the middle of your oven in an oven dish place the oil and allow it to coat the entire bottom if you have not already done so , remove the skin from the drumsticks if you find it difficult to pull the skin off the chicken , use a paper-towel to grip the skin to pull it off on one plate , crack both eggs and whisk them into one uniformed egg wash on a second plate , place the two cups of breadcrumbs spread them out evenly begin by rolling one piece of chicken in the egg mixture make sure the chicken is covered completely and evenly take the chicken and roll it in the breadcrumbs with drumsticks , i find it beneficial to dip the top of the drumstick chicken into the mixture as well as drizzle breadcrumbs in the area of the chicken near the bone since those two areas often do not touch the breadcrumb plate place chicken into dish , meaty side down repeat coating process for all the chicken place dish in oven and allow to cook for about 45 minutes rotate each piece of chicken at this point to allow it crisp throughout about 50 minutes to an hour in , the chicken will appear to fall off the bone the chicken should be done at this point but make sure to check it with a meat thermometer to confirm in the meaty section of the chicken the temperature should reach at least 165 degrees f chicken's done !

name: Simple breaded veggies pasta
ingredients: pasta|broccoli|olive oil|garlic|italian breadcrumbs
steps: prepare pasta , set aside heat oil on a large skillet on med add garlic to the pan and cook for about a minute add chosen vegetables once veggies are heated and coated with oil and garlic take pan of the heat and add bread crumbs stir to coat veggies pour this mixture over prepared pasta sprinkle with parmesan cheese if you want to

name: Simple breading mix
ingredients: flour|breadcrumbs|paprika|salt|black pepper
steps: mix all the ingredients in a small jar & seal with a lid can be stored in a dry place for several months

name: Simple breadsticks
ingredients: bread flour|olive oil|active dry yeast|warm water|sugar|salt
steps: add water yeast and sugar to mixer let sit for a few minutes add oil and salt slowly add flour mix with dough hook until dough balls up divide into 10 equal parts roll out each part on floured surface until they are about 10 inches long place on sprayed cookie sheet spray , cover , and let rise until doubled in size preheat oven to 350 cook for 15 minutes or until browned on top run stick of butter over top of breadsticks and sprinkle with parmesan cheese

name: Simple breakfast casserole
ingredients: eggs|milk|cheddar cheese|sausage|green onion|hash brown patties|salt|pepper|dry mustard
steps: spray with cooking spray and then line an 8x8 baking dish with frozen hash browns sprinkle hash browns with crumbled sausage or bacon and green onions mix together eggs , milk , salt , pepper , and dry mustard pour over meat and hash browns top with grated cheddar cheese let set in refrigerator for about 1 hour cook at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour

name: Simple breakfast potatoes
ingredients: russet potatoes|olive oil|sea salt|dried thyme|dried marjoram|dried rubbed sage|cumin|paprika
steps: place chopped unpeeled potatoes in a big pot and fill with water to about one or two inches above potatoes bring to a boil and simmer on medium heat for about 20 minutes or until tender drain potatoes heat olive oil in a skillet on medium heat add potatoes add seasonings saute until crispy 5-10 minutes serve with your favorite style of breakfast eggs and enjoy !

name: Simple breakfast scramble
ingredients: deli ham|potato|eggs|cheddar cheese|black pepper|tabasco sauce|butter|sour cream
steps: start by putting cleaned , but not peeled , whole potato in microwave for 5 minutes while microwaving potato: melt butter in skillet , dice up ham into small bits once potato is done , remove skin and dice up your "baked" potato throw potato and ham in skillet and turn heat up high once potatoes begin browning , crack eggs and add to skillet--no need to scramble add pepper and tabasco stir vigorously till eggs are almost done add cheese to the skillet and scramble up with the rest as soon as cheese is mostly melted , pour skillet onto a plate smother the top with sour cream

name: Simple brioche
ingredients: all-purpose flour|butter|eggs|dry yeast|fine sugar|2% low-fat milk|salt|egg yolk
steps: in a bowl , mix the flour with the yeast , make a hole in the middle add the warm milk mixing with the add the sugar and a pinch of salt , then add the soft butter , piece after piece , waiting each time that each piece is asborbed then one by one , add the eggs , mixing well between each work the dough until it is elastic and detaches from your fingers more easily cover and let rest in a warm place , away from drafts , for two hours , until it doubles in size work the dough again for 10 min and divide it in four balls place them in a greased rectangular mold and cover let rise for an hour again preheat the oven at 400f brush the brioche with the egg yolk mixed with a dash of sugar with a pair of scissors , make small cuts at the top of each ball place in the oven to bake for 10 min at 400 c , then reduce the heat to 350 f and bake for about 20 to 30 minute remove , unmold and let cool on a rack

name: Simple broccoli casserole
ingredients: frozen chopped broccoli|cream of chicken soup|cream of mushroom soup|herb seasoned stuffing mix|butter
steps: place broccoli and soups in a buttered 1 1 / 2 quart casserole dish mix well toss stuffing with butter in a mixing bowl add to casserole dish stir gently to mix bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 45 minutes

name: Simple broccoli cheese soup
ingredients: butter|onion|broccoli|carrot|campbell's cheddar cheese soup|milk|cheese|kosher salt|fresh ground pepper
steps: melt butter in small boiler , add onions and cook until tender while they are cooking , steam broccoli and carrots in steam bag in microwave for about 4 minutes or until tender move carrots and broccoli into boiler with onions and saute for a minute or two , adding kosher salt and fresh pepper at this point add campbell's cheddar cheese soup and 1 / 2 can of milk and stir until smooth over low heat add cheese to soup when ready to serve for a little kick , add 1 / 4 teaspoon of cajun seasoning while cooking over low heat

name: Simple broccoli rice soup
ingredients: vegetable stock|frozen broccoli florets|minute rice|ground nutmeg|salt and pepper
steps: in a soup pot , combine the vegetable stock and broccoli bring to a boil , and stir in the rice and nutmeg cover tightly , remove from heat , and set aside , undisturbed for about 5 minutes adjust the salt and pepper to taste , and serve immediately

name: Simple broccoli souffle
ingredients: cottage cheese|cheddar cheese|broccoli|butter|flour|salt
steps: mix all ingredients well pour into a greased 1 1 / 2 quart casserole dish bake in a 350 degree oven for one hour

name: Simple brown gravy
ingredients: water|beef bouillon|ground black pepper|kitchen bouquet|butter|garlic powder|onion powder|cornstarch|cold water|oil|flour
steps: boil all ingredients in a pot together , except for thickener once the mixture boils , mix the cold water + cornstarch / oil + flour into a slurry / paste in a small bowl you may need to add a tiny bit more water , but it should be the consistency of runny glue with cornstarch , and a paste with the flour slowly pour in thickener , while stirring continue boiling for 2-3 more minutes , still stirring if you're using flour and oil , simmer at least 5 minutes to be sure the flour cooks remove from heat and let cool to thicken more

name: Simple brown rice jambalaya
ingredients: olive oil|boneless chicken breast|smoked turkey sausage|bell pepper|stewed tomatoes|cooked shrimp|instant brown rice|water
steps: heat olive oil in medium pan over medium heat add cut up chicken and stir around about 10 minutes add sausage and bell pepper and cook 5 minutes add shrimp , stewed tomatoes with juice , rice and water heat to boiling over high heat reduce heat to low and cover with lid simmer 15 minutes until rice is tender

name: Simple brown rice pilaf
ingredients: instant brown rice|chicken stock|butter|green onion|garlic|onion flakes|garlic salt|salt & fresh ground pepper
steps: mix chicken stock and next 5 ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil add rice , return mixture to boil , then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes fluff with fork season with salt and pepper to taste

name: Simple brownie cream cheese squares
ingredients: fudge brownie mix|eggs|oil|water|cream cheese|vanilla|white sugar|flour|mini chocolate chip
steps: the above ingredients for the brownies were those particular to my mix , just follow the directions on the back of the box the cream cheese , while swirled in slightly , should remain on top as this is your "frosting" with a wooden spoon , beat brownie mix , eggs , oil and water together spoon into a pam sprayed 11x16 pan beat softend cream cheese , eggs , and vanilla together until smooth in a small dish , stir the sugar and flour together , then beat into the cream cheese mixture drop spoonfuls of this topping onto the unabaked brownie run a knife across and down the mixture until it is marbeled over the brownie sprinkle with mini chocolate chips bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes , until set chill unitil firm , cut 6 down and 10 across

name: Simple bruschetta
ingredients: butter|basil|parmesan cheese|tomatoes|fresh ground black pepper|whole wheat baguette
steps: heat oven to 375 degrees mix butter , basil paste and parmesan in bowl spread mixture evenly on bread slices top with tomatoes grind fresh pepper over tomatoes place on baking sheet and bake 10 minutes or until crisp

name: Simple buffalo chicken dip
ingredients: butter|red hot sauce|cream cheese|cooked chicken breasts
steps: melt butter , sauce and cream cheese over medium heat , stirring until melted stir in the chicken enjoy right away , or store in the fridge to reheat later serve with thick chips like frito's and celery sticks

name: Simple buffalo wings
ingredients: chicken wings|hot sauce|butter|oil|salt|pepper
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees season chicken to taste heat oil in large skillet until hot fry each piece for about 4 minutes on each side or until done and set on paper towel to drain excess oil meanwhile , mix hot sauce and melted butter together coat each piece of chicken in sauce and place on a cookie sheet drizzle remaining hot sauce mixture over the chicken and bake for 10 minutes

name: Simple bul go gi
ingredients: flank steaks|soy sauce|white sugar|green onion|garlic|sesame oil|toasted sesame seeds|black pepper|peanut oil
steps: combine all ingredients , except sesame seeds , and let marinate minimum 30 minutes quickly cook steak over high heat , using oil sprinkle sesame seeds over dish serve with rice

name: Simple bulgarian banitsa
ingredients: phyllo dough|feta cheese|eggs|salt|butter|milk
steps: 1 preheat oven to 350 degrees , brush melted butter all over bottom amd sides of baking pan 2 mix salt , cheese and milk and eggsin a bowl , combine and stir ingredients well 3 put down 5 sheets of phyllo dough down in buttered pan and brush over with melted butter you can also put down one sheet at a time and butter seperatelly 4 pour enough of the mixture to cover phyllo sheets and top with 3 more sheets 5 continue to repeat the process: put down 3 sheets and make sure to brush them well with butter then layer with mixture until all of the mixture is done , then cover with atleast 2 sheets i preffer not to butter the top sheets as they tend to get very hard after the banitsa is done baking 6 bake for 25-35 minutes or until golden , make sure mixture is cooked in the middle by cutting into banitsa when the mixture is cooked it will not be runny 7 once banitsa is done cover it with either a towell or the lid to the pan and let it sit and cool before cutting it or serving covering it lets the steam soften the phyllo dough sheets

name: Simple bulgur pilaf
ingredients: olive oil|mushrooms|onion|bulgur|water|salt and pepper
steps: heat olive oil and saute onions until soft turn heat up to high and add mushrooms , stirring frequently , until mushrooms are cooked and nicely browned add bulgur , stir and cook briefly , 1-2 minutes add water , mix once , then cover and cook over low heat until all water is absorbed , about 25 minutes fluff briefly before serving

name: Simple burgers
ingredients: hamburger|onion soup mix|worcestershire sauce|garlic salt|dried onion flakes
steps: combine all ingredients with your hands break off sections and form into patty's cook on the stove or bbq

name: Simple burrito casserole
ingredients: tortillas|refried beans|taco seasoning|hamburger|picante sauce|taco cheese|sour cream|tomatoes|lettuce
steps: pre-heat oven to 350 degrees brown hamburger till all pink is gone drain off as much grease as possible on medium low heat stir in refried beans , 3 / 4 jar of picante sauce and burrito seasoning heat till it is all warm and then shut off heat in a greased rectangle cake pan layer the bottom with whole tortillas , tear some of them up to fill in the spaces spread 1 / 2 of the remaining picante sace on top of tortillas then sprinkle with the amount of cheese you desire spread on your bean and meat mixture on top of cheese one more time the tortillas , , cheese , bean and meat mixture put last layer of tortillas on spread the last 1 / 2 of picante sauce on and put cheese on the top bake at 350 degrees till the cheese is melted you may store and cook later or cook right away if you store it , it will take longer to cook if serving immediatly top with sour cream , chopped tomatoes and chopped lettuce

name: Simple but delectable yellow cake mix cookies
ingredients: yellow cake mix|canola oil|eggs|cream cheese frosting|powdered drink mix|candy sprinkles
steps: mix all ingredients for cookies in a large mixing bowl by hand until it is relatively smooth with floured hands pinch a small amount of "dough" and roll into a ball place on ungreased cookie sheet , about 2 inches apart when your cookie sheet is full dip the bottom of a glass jar or a tablespoon in flour and gently press down on the dough balls bake 7-9 minutes @ 350 degrees until a slight golden brown around edges please they can not be baked longer because it will make the cookie to dark let each tray sit 5 minutes before transferring them to a sheet of aluminum foil dusted with powdered sugar after they are cool you can ice them and top off with the sprinkles frosting: if using two or more flavors of drink mix you will need to divide your cream cheese frosting into the appropriate number of small bowls start stirring in small amounts of of the powdered mix stir completely before adding more test for taste add more if wanted a stronger tatse ice cookies and top with your choice of toppings

name: Simple but hearty vegetarian vegetable soup
ingredients: tomato puree|water|vegetable bouillon cubes|potato|turnip|baby carrots|sweet onion|le seuer peas|kidney beans|green beans|frozen corn|cooked macaroni|salt
steps: combine all ingredients except for seasonings and macaroni and bring to a boil lower heat and cook over low-medium heat for 3 hours about halfway through cooking , add the salt , pepper and italian seasoning cook the macaroni separately and just add it in near the end

name: Simple but perfect roasted turkey with gravy
ingredients: turkey|butter|salt|pepper|chicken broth|prepared stuffing|aluminum foil|turkey stock|flour
steps: preheat oven to 350 degree f with the rack in the lowest position place the turkey , breast side up , on a rack in a large roasting pan stuff the cavity loosely , allowing about 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 cup stuffing per pound of turkey combine butter , salt and pepper and rub mixture over the top of the turkey , lifting the skin on the breast slightly to push some of the butter under the skin place the pan in the oven and pour 3 cups of the chicken broth into the bottom of the roasting pan cover loosely with a foil tent baste the turkey about every 30 minutes after about 2-1 / 2 - 3 hours of roasting , remove the foil tent to brown the skin once the foil tent is removed , do not baste to allow the skin to become crispy and evenly brown if the drippings evaporate at any time , add more chicken broth to the bottom of the pan , about 1 to 2 cups at a time roast until the thermometer inserted in the meaty part of the thigh reads 165 degrees f , a 10 - 18 lb turkey will take between 4 - 5 hours to get to temperature , a little less if you have brined your turkey transfer the turkey to a large serving platter , and let it stand for at least 15 to 20 minutes before carving make gravy while turkey stands: strain juices from the bottom of the roasting pan through a fine strainer melt butter in a heavy pot and stir in flour add stock mixture in a stream , whisking constantly to prevent lumps , then bring to a boil , whisking occasionally simmer 5 minutes season gravy with salt and additional pepper to taste

name: Simple but scrumptious split pea soup
ingredients: dried split peas|chicken broth|water|onion|carrot|celery rib|smoked ham hocks|potatoes|garlic clove|clove|bay leaf|salt|pepper
steps: rinse split peas to remove any soil combine peas and all other ingredients in a large pot and bring to a boil simmer , covered for 4 hours or more , until peas are thoroughly cooked , stirring often to combine the ingredients remove the bay leaf and the clove take out the ham hocks or hambone and remove the meat from the bone , and return the meat to the soup serve and enjoy

name: Simple but scrumptious tomato sauce
ingredients: passata|onion powder|garlic cloves|oregano|herbes de provence|salt|pepper
steps: combine everything in a small saucepan heat gently for 10 minute voila ! wonderful on pasta or ricotta ravioli

name: Simple but sensational spinach and feta quiche
ingredients: refrigerated pie dough|muenster cheese|frozen chopped spinach|eggs|parmesan cheese|cream cheese|salt and pepper|garlic powder|feta cheese
