steps: in a large saucepan , bring 4 inches of water to a boil add carrots , beans , and peas cook for 4 minutes drain and rinse in cold water place in a bowl add zucchini and yellow squash , onions , red pepper and olives in a jar with a tight fitting lid , combine oil and next 7 ingredients shake well pour over vegetable mixture and toss to coat refrigerate for up to 1 hour just before serving , sprinkle with parmesan cheese

name: Summer veggies with farfalle
ingredients: farfalle pasta|olive oil|jalapeno|bell pepper|carrot|red onion|summer squash|cherry tomatoes|plum tomatoes|garlic clove|hot chicken broth|fresh basil|capers|salt and pepper
steps: in a large pan heat oil and saut jalapeo , pepper , carrots , onion , and squash for 5 minutes adding little broth if needed add tomatoes , garlic and broth to heat toss in capers and herbs toss in drained pasta to coat season with salt and pepper serve with grated fresh cheese

name: Summer vinaigrette
ingredients: extra virgin olive oil|red wine vinegar|dijon mustard|kikkoman soy sauce|fresh ground black pepper|sugar
steps: mix all ingredients together preferably using a hand held blender if you don't have one , then mix all ingredients except the olive oil with a whisk when mixed , add the olive oil slowly , in a steady stream , to the vinegar mixture , whisking all the time

name: Summer watermelon cooler
ingredients: watermelon|raspberry flavored syrup|ice cube|carbonated water
steps: in a blender or food processor bowl combine the watermelon and the 1 / 3 cup syrup cover and blend or process until smooth press mixture through a fine mesh sieve into a medium bowl discard pulp cover and refrigerate mixture at least 2 hours or up to 24 hours to serve , add ice cubes to ten 12-ounce glasses pour enough watermelon mixture into glasses to fill half full add enough carbonated water to fill glasses if desired , sweeten individual servings with additional syrup stir to dissolve syrup makes 10 servings watermelon ice cubes: use these cubes to keep coolers cold without thinning outflavor cut 1-inch cubes from watermelon flesh place the melon cubes in a single layer in a 15x10x1-inch baking pan freeze for 1 to 2 hours or until firm if storing longer than 4 hours , transfer cubes to a self-sealing plastic freezer bag or freezer container and freeze until ready to use

name: Summer wheat bread abm
ingredients: water|oil|molasses|salt|bread flour|whole wheat flour|active dry yeast
steps: measure and add liquid ingredients to bread pan measure and add dry ingredients to bread pan use finger to form well in the flour and put the yeast in it making sure yeast doesn't come in contact with any liquid put pan in maker and close lid choose "whole wheat" setting and crust color press start

name: Summer wheatberry salad
ingredients: wheatberries|water|kosher salt|bay leaf|artichoke heart|cherry tomatoes|roasted red pepper|capers|scallions|toasted sliced almonds|fresh basil|garlic|fresh lime juice|white wine vinegar|extra virgin olive oil|salt and pepper|greens
steps: in a saucepan with a well-fitted lid , put the the wheatberries , water , salt and bayleaf bring to a boil and then simmer , partially covered until the wheateberries are pleasantly chewy , which may take an hour to an hour and a half remove the pan from the heat , discard the bayleaf , let the berries cool in the liquid when cool , drain and put the wheatberries in a large bowl add the remaining salad ingredients make the vinaigrette by whisking all the ingredients together toss with the salad let sit for about 30 minutes at room temperature to serve , arrange a handful of greens on each plate and top with a generous portion of the salad

name: Summer yogurt fruit pops
ingredients: non-fat vanilla yogurt|vanilla extract|fresh lemon juice|corn syrup|fruit
steps: puree everything but one cup of fruit in a blender add remaining and pulse about 3 times you want the fruit broken down to small pieces pour into 8 one half cup molds they work just fine insert wooden stick into mold and freeze until firm at least four hours when i do i will update

name: Summer yogurt gazpacho
ingredients: greek yogurt|water|cucumber|garlic|ground almonds|green onions|fresh coriander|hard-boiled egg|salt|pepper|cayenne|croutons
steps: in large bowl , combine yogurt and water stir in remaining ingredients , except croutons chill serve garnished with croutons or baked pita wedge

name: Summer yogurt pie
ingredients: fruit yogurt|cool whip|graham cracker pie crust
steps: in large bowl stir together the yogurt and cool whip spoon mixture into graham cracker crust freeze several hours until firm there is no baking required

name: Summer zucchini
ingredients: yellow squash|zucchini|mozzarella cheese|parmesan cheese|fresh basil|extra virgin olive oil|garlic cloves
steps: saute squash and zucchini in olive oil on medium heat for 4 minutes add garlic and saute until squash and zucchini become transparent remove from heat add basil and mozzarella and toss shake parmesan over the top and serve

name: Summer zucchini meatballs
ingredients: ground beef|saltine crackers|milk|egg|garlic|zucchini|basil leaves|garlic salt
steps: in a bowl mix with your hands the first 5 ingredients set aside meanwhile shred the zucchini and sprinkle with garlic salt put shredded zucchini in a colander and put a weight on top to help drain as much liquid as possible in 15 minutes chop the basil add the basil and the drained zucchini to the meat mixture and mix well using your hands roll into balls and put on a sprayed baking sheet and into a 350 degree oven for 15 minutes iif using a high fat meat bake for 20 minutes enjoy !

name: Summer zucchini tuscan pasta
ingredients: small shell pasta|extra virgin olive oil|fresh ground pepper|fresh rosemary|garlic cloves|salt|red pepper flakes|zucchini|diced tomatoes with juice|cannellini beans|salt and pepper
steps: bring large pot of salted water to a boil , and cook according to package directions until al dente over medium heat , add a couple tablespoons of the flavored olive oil to a skilelt , and sautee the zucchini for a couple minutes until bright green gently stir in the beans , 1 / 3 - 1 / 2 cup remaining olive oil , and the tomatoes with their juice heat through and reduce heat to low until pasta finishes cooking drain pasta and toss with sauce check for seasoning , the flavored oil should be enough , but it's always nice to check

name: Summer s bounty soup with pasta
ingredients: olive oil|leeks|saffron thread|carrots|potatoes|turnips|zucchini|green beans|tomatoes|garlic cloves|salt|pepper|vegetable broth|pasta|basil leaves|garlic clove|pine nuts|parmigiano-reggiano cheese
steps: in a large soup pot over medium heat , add the oil stir in leeks and saffron and cook for 10 minutes or until leeks are translucent stir in remaining vegetables - include any juice from the tomatoes and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt cook for 5 more minutes stir in broth / stock and bring to a boil lower the heat to a simmer and cook for 30 more minutes while the soup is simmering cook pasta according to package directions , drain and rinse and set aside meanwhile prepare the pesto: drop basil in a pot of boiling water for a second or so , drain , rinse and pat dry using a food processor process the garlic , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and pine nuts until chopped - add in the basil and olive oil and puree until smooth add cheeses and process until combined stir pasta into soup and ladel soup into bowls , topped with a spoonful of pesto

name: Summer s best bbq beans
ingredients: olive oil|red peppers|onion|tomatoes|kidney beans|tomato sauce|crushed pineapple|molasses|worcestershire sauce
steps: heat oil in large saucepan over medium heat add onion and sweet pepper cook and stir 5 minutes or until tender stir in tomatoes , beans , tomato sauce , undrained pineapple , molasses , and worcestershire sauce bring to boiling , reduce heat simmer , covered , 10 minutes uncover , simmer 10 minutes more or until desired consistency g , cayenne , hot pepper sauce , chipotle peppers in adobe sauce -- whatever stirs your taste buds

name: Summer s bounty soup
ingredients: tomatoes|potatoes|fresh green beans|zucchini|yellow squash|carrots|celery ribs|eggplant|fresh mushrooms|onion|fresh parsley|salt-free garlic and herb seasoning|whole bay leaf|dried thyme|dried basil|v8 vegetable juice
steps: add all the ingredients to a 5-quart slow cooker cover and cook on low for 7-8 hours or until the vegetables are tender season to taste with salt and pepper remove bay leaf before serving

name: Summer s breeze
ingredients: pink grapefruit|lime|cranberry juice|apple juice|red currants
steps: peel , cut and juice the grapefruit and lime pour the juice into a jug and top up with the cranberry and apple juice pour into 4 glasses and garnish with small bunches of red currants

name: Summer s peach frosty
ingredients: peach slices|milk|sugar|ice
steps: place all ingredients in a blender and blend on high for 15 seconds serve immediately

name: Summer s smoked turkey sandwich
ingredients: country bread|mayonnaise|smoked turkey|tomatoes|fresh basil leaves|dill pickle slices
steps: spread one slice of the bread with a teaspoon of mayonnaise layer on the turkey , tomato slices and basil top with the remaining bread slice and cut in half garnish with pickles

name: Summer berry trifle
ingredients: strawberry|blueberries|splenda sugar substitute|fat-free instant vanilla pudding mix|skim milk|angel food cake|sherry wine|dream whip
steps: slice up strawberries , saving a few to garnish sprinkle with splenda and mix with blueberries , set aside prepare pudding as directed with skim milk refrigerate cut or tear 1 / 2 of the angel food cake into 1" cubes / pieces and place at the bottom of a large glass bowl splash 1 tbps sherry onto the cake spoon 1 / 2 of the berry mix on top , spreading evenly spoon 1 / 2 of the pudding on top , spreading evenly repeat with remaining cake , sherry , berries and pudding to make another identical layer prepare dream whip as directed , and use to top the trifle decorate with whole or sliced strawberries and blueberries in a simple design chill for 30 minutes serve in small bowls enjoy !

name: Summerberry ladyfinger trifle
ingredients: ladyfingers|jello instant vanilla pudding mix|strawberry|blueberries|whipped topping
steps: make vanilla or lemon pudding set aside line bottom of bowl with one layer of ladyfingers add 1 / 4 of pudding on top of ladyfingers add 1 / 4 of berries add another layer of ladyfingers add another layer each of pudding and then berries repeat until all ingredients are gone make sure to end with whipped topping garnish with berries if desired

name: Summercool
ingredients: campari|light corn syrup|orange juice|tonic water|ice
steps: mix campari , syrup and orange juice add tonic water and crushed ice pour into four tall glasses
